manifest.name: dsh-notify
manifest.description: Native Windows toast notifications for DeepSeek Harness (dsh), with a Windows-focused system prompt section. Pops the moment the agent stops running — finished / aborted / error / output limit / waiting for your choice / session closed — body labeled with workspace · session, so you can switch windows during long tasks and catch the toast instead of watching a spinner. Pure host-side, zero dependencies, zero build.

bundle.text:
# dsh-notify bundle patch: the toast notification plugin (Windows-focused).
#
# Applied as ONE insert over the profile root, after dsh-base/dsh-web-app rows.
# The user's own profile cordis.patch.yml (and any --patch overlays) is applied
# afterwards and may override this row's whole `config` by id.
#
# `name` must equal the package.json `name` (the loader resolves the plugin
# module from the profile's node_modules under that name).
- insert:
    - id: dsh-plugin-notify
      name: dsh-notify

readme.text:
[**中文**](./README.md) | [English](./README.en.md)

**Windows 原生通知插件**：agent 不再运行时（完成 / 停止 / 出错 / 等你选择 / 会话关闭）自动弹原生 Toast，正文标注「工作区 · 会话」——跑长任务时切走窗口，瞄一眼通知就知道跑完了没。

零运行时依赖、零构建，`dsh plugin add` 一条命令装完即用。
> 真实 Windows Toast 实拍：正文标注「工作区 · 会话」。

- **Windows 原生 Toast 通知**：agent 不再运行时（完成 / 停止 / 出错 / 达到输出上限 / 等你选择 / 会话关闭）自动弹系统通知，正文标注「工作区 · 会话」，一眼知道哪个会话跑完了；
- **防刷屏**：`rootsOnly` 默认仅根会话通知，子代理不刷屏；`cooldownMs` 同会话同类型两次通知最小间隔；
- **安全加固**：弹通知的子进程环境变量经清洗（剔除含 KEY / SECRET / TOKEN / PASSWORD 的变量），不残留凭据与多余进程；
- **Windows 环境系统提示段落**：向 agent 系统提示词注入一段 Windows 环境要点（编码 / 路径 / 进程防坑提示），随总开关 `enabled` 一并启停；
- **零运行时依赖、零构建**，`dsh plugin add` 一条命令装完即用。

- **跑长任务时切走窗口**：LLM 长生成 / 批处理跑着，切到别的应用，任务结束弹通知，瞄一眼就知道结果；
- **挂机批量任务**：一晚上跑多轮任务，全部结束后收到 Toast，不用守着页面；
- **会话多开**：同时跑多个工作区会话，通知正文带「工作区 · 会话」标注，不会搞混；
- **子代理观察**：希望只关注根会话结果时保持 `rootsOnly: true` 默认值，需要观察子代理时再关掉。

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-notify
```

GitHub 安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add github:Pasumao/dsh-plugin-notify`

源码安装（本地开发 / 调试）：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Pasumao/dsh-plugin-notify.git
cd dsh-plugin-notify
npm install

readme.section: 以 link: 方式挂载进 profile（包名 dsh-notify）
readme.text:
```

装完重启 `dsh web` 即生效。

> 兼容性：Windows 10/11 · Node ≥ 22.5 · 实测于 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`。

在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 按 id `dsh-plugin-notify` 覆盖 config。常用项：

| key | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 插件总开关：同时控制 Toast 通知与系统提示段落注入 |
| `cooldownMs` | `10000` | 同会话同类型两次通知的最小间隔（毫秒） |
| `rootsOnly` | `true` | 仅根会话通知，子代理不刷屏 |
| `titlePrefix` | `'dsh'` | 通知标题前缀 |

```powershell
node scripts/test-harness.mjs   # 弹三条真实 Toast 自测
```

- **收不到通知？** 检查 Windows「设置 → 系统 → 通知」是否允许 PowerShell 显示通知，
  以及是否处于专注助手 / 勿扰时段；
- **只想根会话通知？** 保持默认 `rootsOnly: true`；需要观察子代理时再改为 `false`；
- **通知太频繁？** 调大 `cooldownMs`（默认 10000ms）即可。

[中文](./README.md) | **English**

**Native Windows toast notifications for dsh**: when the agent stops running (finished / aborted / error / waiting for your choice / session closed), a native Windows Toast pops up automatically with the body labeled "workspace · session" — switch away from the window during long tasks and one glance at the toast tells you whether it's done.

Zero runtime dependencies, zero build; one `dsh plugin add` command and it's ready to use.
> Real Windows Toast capture: the body is labeled "workspace · session".

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-notify
```

Install from GitHub: `dsh plugin --profile web add github:Pasumao/dsh-plugin-notify`

Install from source (local development / debugging):

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Pasumao/dsh-plugin-notify.git
cd dsh-plugin-notify
npm install

readme.section: Mount into the profile as a link: dependency (package name: dsh-notify)
readme.text:
```

After installing, restart `dsh web` and the plugin is active.

> Compatibility: Windows 10/11 · Node ≥ 22.5 · tested on DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`.
Override the config in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` under the id `dsh-plugin-notify`. Common options:

| key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch: controls both Toast notifications and the system-prompt section injection |
| `cooldownMs` | `10000` | Minimum interval in milliseconds between two notifications of the same type in the same session |
| `rootsOnly` | `true` | Notify only root sessions; subagents won't flood you |
| `titlePrefix` | `'dsh'` | Notification title prefix |

```powershell
node scripts/test-harness.mjs   # Fires three real Toast notifications as a self-test
```
